title: mri_vol2vol
description: Resamples a volume into another field-of-view using various types of matrices (FreeSurfer, FSL, SPM, and MNI).

downsample.description: Downsample factor (e.g., 2) (do not include a targ or registration)
downsample.title: Downsample factor

lta_inv.description: LTA, invert (may not be the same as --lta --inv with --fstal)
lta_inv.title: Inverted LTA

tal.description: Map to a sub FOV of MNI305 (with --reg only)
tal.title: Talairach mapping flag

talxfm.description: Path to the talairach transformation file. Default is talairach.xfm (looks in mri/transforms)
talxfm.title: Talairach transformation file

m3z.description: Non-linear morph encoded in the m3z format
m3z.title: M3Z morph file

inv_morph.description: Compute and use the inverse of the m3z morph
inv_morph.title: Inverse morph flag

fstarg.description: Optionally use the specified volume from the subject in --reg as target. Default is orig.mgz
fstarg.title: FreeSurfer target volume

slice_crop.description: Crop output slices to be within specified start and end indices
slice_crop.title: Slice crop range

slice_reverse.description: Reverse order of slices, update vox2ras
slice_reverse.title: Slice reverse flag

interp.description: Interpolation method: cubic, trilin, or nearest (default is trilin)
interp.title: Interpolation type

fill_average.description: Compute mean of all source voxels in a given target voxel
fill_average.title: Fill average flag

fill_conserve.description: Compute sum of all source voxels in a given target voxel
fill_conserve.title: Fill conserve flag

mul.description: Multiply output by the specified value
mul.title: Multiplication factor

keep_precision.description: Set output precision to that of the input
keep_precision.title: Keep input precision flag

kernel.description: Save the trilinear interpolation kernel at each voxel instead of the interpolated image
kernel.title: Trilinear interpolation kernel flag

copy_ctab.description: Setenv FS_COPY_HEADER_CTAB to copy any ctab in the mov header
copy_ctab.title: Copy ctab flag

map_point.description: Standalone option to map a point to another space
map_point.title: Map point parameters

map_point_inv_lta.description: Same as --map-point but inverts the LTA
map_point_inv_lta.title: Inverted LTA map point parameters

no_resample.description: Do not resample, just change vox2ras matrix
no_resample.title: No resampling flag

rot.description: Rotation angles (degrees) to apply to registration matrix
rot.title: Rotation angles

trans.description: Translation (mm) to apply to registration matrix
trans.title: Translation distances

shear.description: Shearing factors. Sxy Sxz Syz with xz as in-plane
shear.title: Shearing factors

reg_final.description: Final registration matrix after rotation and translation (but not inversion)
reg_final.title: Final registration matrix

synth.description: Replace input with white Gaussian noise
synth.title: Synthesize noise flag

seed.description: Seed for synth (default is to set from time of day)
seed.title: Random seed

save_reg.description: Write out output volume registration matrix
save_reg.title: Save registration flag

version.description: Print out version string and exit
version.title: Version flag
